title: ICLR27: Received a review that seems to be for an entirely different paper. Has anyone experienced this? [D]
summary: Got my reviews yesterday, and honestly, I'm starting to question the credibility of the entire review process. One of the reviewers seems to have submitted a review for a completely different paper. And I don't mean they misunderstood our method or missed the main contribution. T
reason: Reddit discussion/commentary about a peer-review experience; no research artifact, paper link, official announcement, policy action, or tool release. No rule covers it.
